about_the_game:
This game is an update version of the previous WTC OVN series in one handy game.  Some dialogue and graphics have been updated.

OVN 1

Taking place on the unluckiest day of the year, the protagonist and his/her friends get an invite to "The Beach". Mistaking this for a private beach party, they are sorely disappointed when instead of everyone being able to have fun, they have to instead search for three parts of a missing sword.

Events become more complicated when two unwanted characters turn up.

OVN 2

It's a special day for two people.  One wants a quiet day, whilst the other wants answers to an important question.

Will either of them get what they want ?

OVN 3

When a guest at The Violet Hotel is found dead in his room, Grendel Jinx and the protagonist are given a choice : Either investigate the untimely (and potentially financially problematic) demise of a paying guest, or pay for the damage caused by Grendels newest "purchases".

Naturally choosing the easiest (and least expensive) option, Grendel and the protagonist set about solving the mystery.

Unfortunately for the duo, investigating the death of a guest is the least of their problems.

Can Grendel and the protagonist solve the mystery or will they be stuck in each other's bodies 

  • Gender selection for the protagonist (male, female or a random choice between the two)

  • Story has been slightly tweaked in a few areas with some grammatical errors fixed over the previous versions

  • Achievements from all three episodes have been combined

  • Some episodes have multiple endings, driven by player choices
